adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a `raw_html` cook method that explicitly bypasses the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline: `Post#cook` returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb). Imported feed/readability content is stored with this mode (`TopicEmbed.import` passes `cook_method: ...[:raw_html]` via `PostCreator`, and `PollFeed` passes `i.content` through only `CGI.unescapeHTML(...scrub)` which is not HTML sanitization). The embed UI then renders the stored HTML unescaped via `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Together, this allows attacker-controlled HTML/JS from the embeddable host/feed to be persisted and executed in the Discourse origin (stored XSS).
